Source C3b export SHA: `01f1c07ae53847a4b4a2d4938d1d22782bb5529ea1696a7e5f05268f242aff5a`. The initial D1 driver stopped because it tried ascending with less than four energy. Its failure export SHA is `39e3afa50c3c35c56928d76903e9fb8ff4014c4792caaa1e57bfd6983c0af759`; the successful continuation resumes those exact bytes, solar charges, returns, completes the basalt commission and returns home. Its `continuation/result.json` reports five check groups and zero browser errors. This does not make the original process successful. The separate survey branch starts the preaccept bytes, completes the optional roots survey and returns home; its result reports two groups and zero errors, preserving the main export SHA.

The native UI earned a broker inheritance from recorded allied tribe and trade civilization; unknown early diet gives no invented votes. The first fourteen C3b economic receipts remain exact. Two later eight-unit sales earn 80 before and 96 after the resin treaty, giving balance 425, revenue 488, and empty final cargo. Main continuation has all three treaties and six newly paid roots role scans; the first discovery metadata remains unchanged. The branch instead earns a roots survey badge by landing on star 5, adds no biology scans and does not contact basalt.

All three actual internal generation checkpoints are the old pre-purchase checkpoint at tick 66066: no ship, empty biology/account/registry, and independent activation cuts. Driver save/export/import milestones are not new generation checkpoints. Tests that call `makeCheckpoint` or prepare proximity explicitly create unit-only continuations; they do not claim those checkpoints or inputs were played in the browser. Parsing preserves historical account v2 and does not automatically enable D2 equipment. Local load, rekey, exact recovery and malformed receipts are unit regressions.

Native evidence uses ordinary UI and real time, with no live setters, artificial time or injected resources. It does not establish fresh-birth reachability, human playtest or human listening acceptance. Screenshots, performance and cleanup remain in the main report; fixture copies must not be edited to repair a test.
